statement: Keep approved work progressing end to end without human coordination between tasks, roles, failures or GitHub stages.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: A grant covering at least two dependent tasks executes them in order through completion without routine human handoffs or per-task selection.
AC-02: Real isolated role sessions, validators, reviews, legal rework, PR/CI and controlled merge are driven by the same existing authority owners.
AC-03: Semantic failure creates an auditable successor attempt when allowed; infrastructure retry preserves identity; budgets survive restart.
AC-04: Duplicate starts/events and uncertain side effects cannot duplicate assignment, evidence, active provider work, PRs or merge.
AC-05: Out-of-scope work, exhausted budgets, unsafe recovery and unresolved clarification become durable actionable exceptions.
AC-06: Cancellation, revocation and pause/drain reflect real external writers and retain a supported resume path.
AC-07: Service/CLI operation semantics align with #75 and use the installed package; no competing supervisor is introduced.
